function: Joint control of SIM phase shifts and uplink transmit power of mobile users to maximize achievable secrecy rate against an eavesdropper (pp. 5-6).
system: Uplink: multi-antenna BS with stacked SIM in radome (M=4 layers, N=36 meta-atoms), K=2 single-antenna mobile users, one single-antenna eavesdropper; 3.5 GHz (pp. 4, 11).
method: PPO-BOP: actor-critic deep reinforcement learning (PPO) with multi-head self-attention, Bi-LSTM feature network, off-policy data reuse and policy feedback; online reinforcement training (pp. 7-10).
data_channel: Own simulated spatially correlated Rician fading (factor 10 dB, path-loss exponent 2.0), random-walk mobility in a 100 m square; online training episodes, no dataset (pp. 4-5, 11).
test_conditions: Training and evaluation in the same simulated environment: 2000 episodes, 40 time slots each, K=2 MUs; sweeps of Pmax, RHI, SIM size (pp. 11-13).
baselines: Non-learned: single-antenna BS without SIM, uniform SIM phase pi with Pmax/2 or Pmax power; learned: DDQN, DDPG, TD3, SAC, PPO (p. 11).
metrics: Average achievable secrecy rate (ASR, bit/s/Hz) versus training episodes, Pmax, RHI level, SIM layers and meta-atoms; episode reward; hyper-parameter sensitivity (pp. 11-13).
complexity: Big-O training and execution complexity (execution O(Gamma)) and space complexity; no runtime or FLOPs (pp. 10-11).
q1_support: p. 4: "assumed to follow a spatially correlated Rician fading channel model [46]"; own simulator (Table I, p. 11: path-loss exponent 2.0, Rician factor 10 dB), with no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "Fig. 6 illustrates the ASR of the proposed system using PPO-BOP at different RHI levels"; only parameter sweeps (RHI, Pmax, layers, meta-atoms) in one setting, and no model trained in one condition is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 11: "Uniform SIM Phase Shift and Transmit Power" (fixed, non-learned) and "double deep Q-network (DDQN) [55], the deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) [13], the twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3) [59], soft actor-critic (SAC) [60], and PPO [61]", all compared on ASR (Figs. 3-5).
q4_support: p. 11: "The CC of the execution phase mainly includes feature extraction and action generation, which is O(Γ)"; p. 10 gives the order of the training-phase complexity.
q5_support: p. 4: "assumed to follow a spatially correlated Rician fading channel model [46]" (own simulated channel); no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is stated anywhere, including the conclusion (p. 13).
notes: ris=1: the SIM is a stacked (multi-layer, transmissive) metasurface in the BS radome. Area 3 because the DRL agent configures the SIM phase shifts and user power; the secrecy-rate (physical-layer security) objective is not an excluded function, but the reviewer may confirm. q3: plain PPO is the base of the proposed method and is not relied on; DDQN, DDPG, TD3 and SAC are standard learned baselines.
